# `r cv_section_icon("graduation-cap")` Education

```{r eduaction}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

education <- tribble(
  ~ Degree, ~ Year, ~ Institution, ~ Where,
  "Doctor of Philosophy in Biological Sciences", "2020-24", "Université de Montréal", "Montréal, Canada",
  "Master of Science in Ecology and Biodiversity", "2018-20", "Stockholms Universitet", "Stockholm, Sweden",
  "Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Plant Sciences", "2017", "University of Pretoria", "Pretoria, South Africa",
  "Bachelor of Science in Ecology", "2014-16", "University of Pretoria", "Pretoria, South Africa"
) 

cv_entries(education, with = "Degree", when = "Year",
           what = "Institution", where = "Where")
```
